method.quadrature: Azimuth mean; integrate in sin²(theta), linearly between samples, hold the 89-degree mean through 90 degrees.
method.lanes: Select matched pairs round robin across 15/30-degree cone strength, fraction, and their product. Each lane uses the better single wall profile of each pair.
method.g05: Include G05 as a comparison point if it remains top 12 in either cone strength lane.
method.limits: M0 ideal black floor and mirror walls. Engineering ratios are descriptors, not fabrication pass criteria. Residual intervals exclude angular and spatial sampling error.
